cases.scenario: Validate documentation metadata and module contract structure without executing product tests

expectations.statement: The module contract structure and referenced source paths are valid.
Invalid module contract structure cannot pass the structural check.

cases.scenario: Current source inventory resolves to one owned unit and registered cases.

expectations.statement: Every governed source has unique existing ownership.
New unregistered sources cannot silently inherit a whole-application gate.

cases.scenario: The release workflow binds triggers, history and reproducible dependencies.

expectations.statement: Bounded triggers, pinned actions and sanitized telemetry persist.
Unbounded CI execution or raw telemetry persistence is forbidden.

cases.scenario: CI and lockfile supply-chain inputs are checked structurally.

expectations.statement: Immutable actions, least privilege and locked installers are accepted.
Mutable actions, write permissions and unlocked installers are rejected.

cases.scenario: Canonical exact runners collect and execute the same restricted test identities.

expectations.statement: Pytest, Vitest and Playwright selectors retain exact identity and selected counts.
Collection never writes source files or accepts skipped, duplicate or unselected identities.

cases.scenario: Selected runners prepare only the prerequisites their selected tests need.

expectations.statement: Missing build artifacts are rebuilt for selected previews and E2E data stays inside isolation.
Failed prerequisites cannot launch dependent tests and default execution cannot scan installed distributions.

cases.scenario: Exercise execution contracts in test_verification_resume.py

expectations.statement: The execution regression suite accepts supported inputs and records valid outcomes.
The execution regression suite rejects unsupported or inconsistent inputs without false success.

cases.scenario: The development process supervisor shuts down its owned process tree.

expectations.statement: The parent and its descendant stop on shutdown.
Owned descendants must not remain running after shutdown.

cases.scenario: Nuxt generated tsconfig and ESLint module imports remain usable across Windows drive paths.

expectations.statement: Broken ./D:/ tsconfig paths normalize and generated ESLint Windows imports become encoded file URLs; repeated normalization is idempotent.
Relative imports, existing file URLs and ordinary data strings cannot be rewritten as module paths.

cases.module_name: 公开问答消费层（默认关闭）
cases.scenario: Managed worker reads real .env.e5, validates settings, runs against its database and closes resources on stop; existing launcher reuse and owner-stop behavior hold.

expectations.statement: Managed worker reads real .env.e5, validates settings, runs against its database and closes resources on stop; existing launcher reuse and owner-stop behavior hold.
Disabled worker cannot open the database; duplicate ready managers and unowned process termination are forbidden.
A launcher invokes the manager spawn exactly once with the hidden Windows and new-process-group flags in both the early-exit and reported-failure paths, including when tests run on another platform.
An early manager exit cannot wait through the full startup timeout, and a reported terminal failure cannot be printed more than once.

cases.scenario: Text PDF extraction preserves pages and rejects unsupported content.

expectations.statement: Text PDF extraction preserves pages and rejects unsupported content.
Unsupported or unbounded parsing must never yield usable evidence.

cases.scenario: Real child process enforces resource and IO boundaries and is reaped on deadline.

Unsupported or unbounded parsing must never yield usable evidence.

cases.scenario: Bounded content cache, migration, same-hash reuse and binding revocation.

expectations.statement: Bounded content cache, migration, same-hash reuse and binding revocation.
Revoked, failed or superseded resume versions must never be usable or overwrite a current version.

cases.scenario: Worker imports outside write locks, drops replaced work, reuses unchanged PDFs and has no timer.

expectations.statement: Worker imports outside write locks, drops replaced work, reuses unchanged PDFs and has no timer.
GET cannot trigger import, late work cannot revive old content, and attempts cannot continue indefinitely.

cases.scenario: M10.index: Chinese and English natural questions reach the lexical branch of hybrid retrieval.

cases.scenario: 生产构建保持单列登录、当前页面标题、键盘导航、触控和 WCAG A/AA。

expectations.statement: 生产构建保持单列登录、当前页面标题、键盘导航、触控和 WCAG A/AA。
不允许横向溢出、自动无障碍违规、错误页面或失效操作。

cases.scenario: Playwright configurations preserve isolated server inputs and validate alternate browser ports.

expectations.statement: Development, failure and assistant browser servers retain explicit build directories, trusted loopback settings and per-run roots; a valid alternate Web port remains usable.
Ambient server reuse, trusted arbitrary forwarded IPs, invalid ports and API/Web port collisions cannot silently pass the configuration boundary.

cases.scenario: Git paths and source drift remain readable under a non-UTF-8 Windows locale.

expectations.statement: A real Git repository with Chinese paths yields exact UTF-8 NUL-separated changed paths, source drift entries and its current commit hash under a cp936 locale.
The host default encoding cannot corrupt path identities or turn successful Git output into a missing stdout value.

cases.scenario: Reference desktop and mobile shell preserves navigation, theme, focus, logout and local icons.

expectations.statement: Responsive sidebar dimensions, ten local navigation icons including account security, active paths and both theme colors match the selected shell; controls remain reachable at short heights.
No horizontal overflow, missing icon, axe violation, trapped background or residual scroll lock after Escape, route or breakpoint close; failed logout remains visible and real retry succeeds.

expectations.statement: Stop retains pending/cost notice; successful restore clears old error; long themed dialog remains usable with server pagination parameters.
No duplicate pending submissions, false clearing on failure, stale recovery error after success, or horizontal overflow.

cases.scenario: Centered studio login remains accessible and authenticates a real safe return path.

expectations.statement: Both themes share a centered 430px desktop form with safe 320/390/768px margins, heading and return link; Enter submits real credentials to the requested admin route.
No obsolete two-column panel, horizontal overflow, axe violation or browser hydration warning.

expectations.statement: Twelve isolated login, list, creation, editor, preview and history surfaces preserve theme tokens, fit 320–1440px and 480px short viewports, switch mobile sections and Markdown/preview by keyboard, with zero axe violations.
No horizontal overflow, inaccessible hidden settings, duplicate visible editor/preview, browser page errors or warnings.
